ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Idle`. `start` is already true, but a transition is not checked in the tick its state is entered, so nothing else happens.
`start` is still true: an input keeps its value until it is changed. Now `Idle`'s transition is checked. It fires, sets `heating` to true and moves to `Cooking`, all in this tick.
`start` is released. `Cooking` only reacts to `door`, so nothing fires, and `heating` keeps the value it was given in tick 2.
The door opens. The transition back to `Idle` fires and switches `heating` off in the same tick.
The door shuts. `Idle` waits for the next `start`.
